package.name: nidar_airmouse
package.description: Custom message definitions for the NIDAR AirMouse Drone-to-GCS interface. Currently just SurvivorDetection.msg, matching custom-gcs/docs/DATA_MODELS.md section 5. This package exists because the GCS backend (custom-gcs/gcs/backend) subscribes to /vision/survivors as type nidar_airmouse/SurvivorDetection and fails to subscribe without this package installed on the Jetson.
